title: Entropy Contribution Activation Guide
description: Step-by-step guide to enable Entropy Contribution on your device

steps.title: Navigate to Tasks
steps.description: From the main dashboard, tap the Tasks icon in the bottom navigation bar to access the Unetwork Tasks menu.

steps.title: Locate Entropy Contribution
steps.description: In the Unetwork Tasks screen, scroll down to find 'Entropy Contribution'. This feature allows your device to contribute high-quality randomness used to help secure online systems. It runs in the background and can be turned off anytime.

steps.title: Enable Entropy Contribution
steps.description: Tap the toggle switch to enable Entropy Contribution. The status will briefly show 'Starting' as the service initializes.

steps.title: Confirm Activation
steps.description: Once initialization is complete, the status will change to 'Active' with a green indicator. Your device is now contributing entropy to help secure online systems.
